step1_analysis.description: A 5th-order Cauer (elliptic) passive RLC low-pass filter prototype. It serves as the continuous-time reference model for the switched-capacitor ladder filter described in the paper, providing steep roll-off for anti-aliasing.

paper_reference.title: Embedded Anti-Aliasing in Switched-Capacitor Ladder Filters With Variable Gain and Offset Compensation

cutoff_frequency.description: The -3dB bandwidth of the low-pass filter.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the passive L and C values. Set to match the paper's target of 1.92 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The passive prototype components are chosen to yield the 1.92 MHz cutoff frequency reported in the paper.

stopband_suppression.description: Attenuation in the stopband to prevent aliasing at the sampling frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Measured as the difference between DC gain and the gain at the 30.72 MHz sampling frequency.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A 5th-order elliptic filter provides steep roll-off, easily achieving >40dB suppression at 30.72 MHz when the cutoff is 1.92 MHz.

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency insertion loss of the filter.

sky130_expected.calculation: For this passive prototype driven by an ideal voltage source, DC gain is 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The netlist is a passive RLC ladder. At DC, inductors act as short circuits, connecting VOUT directly to IIN.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the cutoff frequency, DC gain, and stopband attenuation of the passive RLC filter prototype.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Passive RLC Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT with representative values for 1.92MHz cutoff
R1 IIN GND 1k
C1 IIN GND 80p
L2 IIN N1 100u
C3 N1 GND 150p
C4 N1 VOUT 20p
L4 N1 VOUT 100u
C5 VOUT GND 80p
R5 VOUT GND 1k

* Stimulus
VIIN IIN GND DC 0 AC 1

.control
ac dec 100 1k 100Meg
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)

* Measure DC Gain (at 1kHz)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k

* Measure -3dB Cutoff Frequency
let gain_3db = dc_gain - 3
meas ac cutoff_frequency when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

* Measure Stopband Suppression at 30.72 MHz
meas ac gain_at_fs find gain_db at=30.72Meg
let stopband_suppression = dc_gain - gain_at_fs

print dc_gain cutoff_frequency stopband_suppression
quit
.endc
